name: Path Dimension / Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For half-intervals $\mathcal I_n$, $\mathrm P(\mathcal I_n)=n-1$ while $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{peq}}(\mathcal I_n)=\log n$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{peq}}(\mathcal S_n)=n-1$ while $\mathrm P(\mathcal S_n)=1$.
proof: The recorded Half-interval and Singleton value formulae give unbounded gaps in opposite directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Path Dimension and Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity of Half-intervals and Singletons.
